evals.name: agent-loop-hero-ring
evals.prompt: we're launching the Dreambase agent on our marketing site. I want one of those dark schematic diagrams — like Linear's — showing the agent loop: ingest data → profile schema → detect anomalies → draft report → human review, with 'detect anomalies' as the currently-active stage. build it as an SVG I can drop in the hero. save as agent-loop.svg
evals.expected_output: A dark orbital-ring SVG: tilted ellipse with dense radial tick marks, five node markers with uppercase monospace tracked labels, exactly one active node with glow and a bright progress arc ending at it, far side dimmed/blurred, film grain overlay, monochrome white-on-near-black palette
assertions: Output is a self-contained SVG on a near-black ground with a tilted (elliptical, rotated) ring — not a face-on flowchart or circle diagram
Ring carries a dense radial tick corona (dozens of ticks pointing at the center), not a plain outline
All five stages appear as node markers with UPPERCASE monospace labels using visible letter-spacing
Exactly one focal highlight: the active stage ('detect anomalies') gets the glowing dot and/or bright arc; other nodes are dim
Depth is rendered: far side of the ring is dimmer and/or blurred relative to the near side
Palette is monochrome white/gray on black for the ring scene (no rainbow stage colors, no gradients on shapes)

evals.name: exploded-engine-illustration
evals.prompt: for the 'under the hood' section of our docs I want an illustration of our query engine drawn like a piece of camera/turbine hardware, exploded view style, dark background with those warm edge highlights. SVG please, save to query-engine.svg
evals.expected_output: A cel-shaded flat-vector machinery illustration: stacked cylinder segments exploded along a single axis, 3-4 flat gray values on a warm charcoal ground, thin warm peach rim-light slivers on one consistent lit side, repetition details (knurling/ticks/bolts), optional muted red accent ring, no gradients
assertions: Machinery is built from cylinder/ellipse cross-sections sharing one axis and one consistent ellipse aspect, exploded along that axis only
Shading is flat cel-style: at most ~4 gray fill values plus rim + accent, zero gradients
Rim highlight is a thin warm (peach/cream) sliver appearing only on one consistent light side
Detail comes from repeated small elements (knurling, tick rings, slots) rather than outlines or texture fills
Any red accent is muted and confined to tick/calibration marks, never large fills
Background is dark charcoal and the shadow side of the object blends toward it

evals.name: hud-progress-component
evals.prompt: our dashboard needs a progress scrubber in that technical HUD style — the tick-mark strip like on a camera lens readout, showing sync progress with the current position highlighted. make it a small self-contained HTML/CSS component with a way to set progress
evals.expected_output: A tick-strip ruler component: rounded dark track, evenly spaced thin vertical ticks, completed ticks in muted red, one taller/brighter active tick, remaining ticks faint gray; progress settable (CSS custom property or JS/attribute); monospace uppercase micro-label if labeled; reduced-motion respected if animated
assertions: Component renders a row of many thin evenly-spaced vertical tick marks on a dark rounded track (not a solid progress bar fill)
Three tick states are visually distinct: completed (muted red), active (brighter/taller, at most one), and upcoming (faint gray)
Progress is parameterized (CSS custom property, data attribute, or JS API) rather than hardcoded
Any text label is small, uppercase, monospace, letter-spaced
If animated, animation is wrapped in a prefers-reduced-motion guard
Component is self-contained (no external fonts, libraries, or images)

evals.name: hologram-mesh-donut
evals.prompt: make a hero graphic of our platform's capability mix as one of those green hologram wireframe 3D donut charts — like a terminal/Matrix style mesh floating at an angle — segments: MCP Tools 30%, Skills 25%, REST APIs 25%, Headless 20%, with labels pointing at each segment. SVG, save as capability-mesh.svg
evals.expected_output: A 3D extruded donut rendered as a phosphor-green wireframe mesh: tilted via x/y/z rotation with perspective, bright structural edges + dim interior grid, translucent or transparent fills, elbow callout leaders with node dots and uppercase mono labels, everything monochromatic in the green hue including background tint
assertions: Donut is a 3D extruded mesh viewed from a rotated camera (tilted ellipse + visible walls), not a flat 2D pie
Two-level line hierarchy: bright structural edges (arcs, verticals) and visibly dimmer interior grid lines (spokes, rings, wall lines)
Fills are transparent or dark translucent tints of the same green hue — no opaque neutral grays, no gradients
Segment shares match the given percentages proportionally (30/25/25/20)
Each labeled segment has an elbow callout leader (anchor dot, diagonal + horizontal rule, uppercase mono label) that does not cross the mesh
Entire scene is monochromatic in one green hue family — lines, glow, labels, and background tint all share the hue
